parts.name: scene cards
parts.about: Before each chapter the writer plans its scenes (answer kind `scenes`) and an independent AI checks the plan (`scene_review`); a plan that fails is planned again, then the chapter is written from the cards.

parts.name: the writer (C01 context and C02 prose)
parts.about: Akọwe builds the chapter's context (C01, no AI) and the writer AI writes the chapter's prose (C02, answer kind `C02`); Akọwe's checks read it before any review.

parts.name: review & fix loop
parts.about: `_review_until_approved`: Akọwe's checks, then an independent AI reviewer (`review`); REVISE/REJECT → the AI fixes it (`fix`, at most MAX_FIXES = 2), a fix the checks refuse is repaired (MAX_REPAIRS = 2) or the last good version comes back; still not approved → the author (or the stand-in vote) decides.

parts.name: editor
parts.about: After the consistency APPROVE the AI editor scores the chapter (`craft`); REVISE → the writer reworks only the flagged passages (`rewrite`), kept only when nothing got worse; notes that remain are flagged ⚠️ and never block the book.

parts.name: cut pass
parts.about: `cut_pass.py`: one tough-editor call per chapter (`cuts`) proposes about 10 % of labelled cuts; Akọwe checks every cut, caps the total at 14 %, applies them as a new version, reviews it and keeps it only when that passes — else the earlier text comes back.

parts.name: subtext check
parts.about: `subtext_check.py`: lines of dialogue that say a feeling outright are found without AI; one AI (`subtext`) confirms them and gives subtler lines; the rewrite is reviewed and kept only on APPROVE — else the earlier text comes back.

finding.where: akowe/akowe/subtext_check.py chapter_pass ~line 255-258 (log.exception("subtext check of %s", …))
finding.cause: an ordinary AI failure of the subtext check (timeout, refusal, unusable or empty answer) is caught by the catch-all and logged with log.exception: an ERROR line with a full traceback for every chapter, although the book goes on correctly (the cut pass logs the same kind of failure as one INFO line)
finding.fix: Catch AkoweError separately and log it at INFO / WARNING with its code only; keep log.exception for real bugs
finding.what: an AI that cannot do the subtext check fills akowe.log with ERROR tracebacks (the book still finishes and the journal says SUBTEXT_CHECK_FAILED)
